# Whisper Security — Claude Code Plugins

Claude Code plugins for [Whisper Security](https://whisper.security) threat intelligence platform.

## Installation

```bash
# Add the marketplace
/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/whisper-sec/claude-whisper-plugins.git

# Install individual plugins
/plugin install whisper-feeds@whisper-security --scope user
/plugin install whisper-graph@whisper-security --scope user
/plugin install whisper-investigate@whisper-security --scope user
/plugin install whisper-recon@whisper-security --scope user
/plugin install whisper-audit@whisper-security --scope user
```

## Plugins

### whisper-feeds

Query Whisper threat intelligence feeds via natural language.

**Skills:** `feeds-query`

**Capabilities:** Check IPs/domains/hashes against 50+ threat feeds, BGP routing, ASN reputation, toxic neighborhoods, routing anomalies.

**Examples:**
```
/whisper-feeds:feeds-query check 8.8.8.8
/whisper-feeds:feeds-query ASN reputation 13335
/whisper-feeds:feeds-query toxic neighborhoods
```

---

### whisper-graph

Graph v2 query interface and fast indicator enrichment — powered by a 2.7B-node, 19.7B-edge infrastructure graph.

**Skills:** `graph-query`, `graph-v2-reference`, `enrich-ip`, `enrich-domain`

**Capabilities:**
- Interactive NL-to-Cypher query loop
- Full graph schema reference (14 node labels, 14+ edge types)
- Fast domain enrichment (DNS, subdomains, NS/MX, SPF, threat status)
- Fast IP enrichment (ASN, prefix, geolocation, threat status, neighborhood toxicity)

**Examples:**
```
/whisper-graph:graph-query what ASN hosts example.com?
/whisper-graph:enrich-domain example.com
/whisper-graph:enrich-ip 8.8.8.8
```

---

### whisper-investigate

Deep security investigation and attack surface mapping.

**Skills:** `investigate`, `blast-radius`, `attack-surface-v3`

**Capabilities:**
- Deep dive on any indicator (IP, domain, hash, ASN)
- Resilience-aware blast radius analysis (ECS probing, NS diversity, CDN/origin separation)
- Full EASM mapping (subdomain enumeration, infrastructure resolution, email security, risk scoring)

**Examples:**
```
/whisper-investigate:investigate 185.220.101.1
/whisper-investigate:attack-surface-v3 example.com
/whisper-investigate:blast-radius cloudflare.com
```

---

### whisper-recon

Specialized reconnaissance for targeted assessments.

**Skills:** `pre-chain-recon`, `temporal-intel`, `insight`

**Capabilities:**
- Pre-chain Web2-to-Web3 attack surface mapping for crypto/FinTech targets
- Certificate Transparency monitoring, IP churn detection, campaign correlation
- Single "aha moment" finding for live demos

**Examples:**
```
/whisper-recon:pre-chain-recon kraken.com
/whisper-recon:temporal-intel example.com
/whisper-recon:insight example.com
```

---

### whisper-audit

Practitioner-led evaluation walkthrough for prospects.

**Skills:** `evaluation`

**Capabilities:**
- 30-min practitioner-led evaluation walkthrough (read-only, no installs)
- Graph correlation, attack surface visibility, shadow DNS, change-over-time monitoring

**Examples:**
```
/whisper-audit:evaluation example.com
```

---

## Setup

On first use, you'll be asked for your Whisper API key. Config is saved to `~/.claude/whisper-feeds.local.md` (gitignored, never committed).

Default API endpoint: `https://dev.whisper.security`

Override by editing `~/.claude/whisper-feeds.local.md`:
```yaml
---
base_url: https://your-instance.example.com
api_key: your-key-here
---
```
